steps.title: Update `gradle/libs.versions.toml`: Add dependencies for Ktor Client, Kotlinx Coroutines, Kotlinx Serialization, and the serialization plugin to support `NetworkClient.kt` in the `shared` module.
Verify `gradle/libs.versions.toml` Update: Run `cat gradle/libs.versions.toml` to verify the added dependencies.
Update `shared/build.gradle.kts`: Add Ktor Client and Serialization dependencies to the `commonMain` source set, and apply the serialization plugin.
Verify `shared/build.gradle.kts` Update: Run `cat shared/build.gradle.kts` to confirm the additions.
Update `Constants.kt`: Edit `shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sekota/Constants.kt` to include necessary constants (e.g., base URL and endpoints).
Verify `Constants.kt` Update: Read the updated `Constants.kt` file.
Create `NetworkClient.kt`: Create `shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sekota/NetworkClient.kt` implementing a Ktor HTTP client.
Verify `NetworkClient.kt` Creation: Run `cat shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/sekota/NetworkClient.kt`.

Create `Navbar.kt`: Create `composeApp/src/webMain/kotlin/com/sekota/Navbar.kt` incorporating a sticky glassmorphism header, Sekota Logo, Nav Links (Produk, Solusi, Tentang Kami, Kontak), and a CTA Button as defined in `.requirements/landing_page_requirements.md`.
Verify `Navbar.kt` Creation: Run `cat composeApp/src/webMain/kotlin/com/sekota/Navbar.kt`.

Create `HeroSection.kt`: Create `composeApp/src/webMain/kotlin/com/sekota/HeroSection.kt` with Montserrat ExtraBold heading "Trusted Intelligence.", subtext in DM Sans, a CTA Button, and layer blur visual effects as defined in the requirements.
Verify `HeroSection.kt` Creation: Run `cat composeApp/src/webMain/kotlin/com/sekota/HeroSection.kt`.
Create `SidebarFilter.kt`: Create `composeApp/src/webMain/kotlin/com/sekota/SidebarFilter.kt` containing Search and category filtering (T-Shirt, Pin, Sticker, Others) as defined in the requirements.
Verify `SidebarFilter.kt` Creation: Run `cat composeApp/src/webMain/kotlin/com/sekota/SidebarFilter.kt`.
Update `App.kt`: Update `composeApp/src/webMain/kotlin/com/sekota/App.kt` to integrate the newly created `Navbar`, `HeroSection`, and `SidebarFilter` components into the main view.
Verify `App.kt` Update: Run `cat composeApp/src/webMain/kotlin/com/sekota/App.kt`.
Create `Dockerfile`: Add `Dockerfile` at the project root for the application infrastructure.
Verify `Dockerfile` Creation: Run `cat Dockerfile`.
Create `compose.yaml`: Add `compose.yaml` at the project root to orchestrate the Docker container.
Verify `compose.yaml` Creation: Run `cat compose.yaml`.

Build and Test Project: Run `./gradlew check` or `./gradlew build` via `run_in_bash_session` to verify that all new code, dependencies, and UI components compile successfully, and all existing tests pass.
Pre-commit: Complete pre-commit steps to ensure proper testing, verifications, reviews, and reflections are done.
Submit: Submit the changes to the `sprint-1` branch.

diff --git a/update_toml.py b/update_toml.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..06ba117
--- /dev/null
+++ b/update_toml.py
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+import sys
+
+with open('gradle/libs.versions.toml', 'r') as f:
+    content = f.read()
+
+# Fix the appended syntax error
+content = content.replace('kotlinMultiplatform = { id = "org.jetbrains.kotlin.multiplatform", version.ref = "kotlin" }ktor-clientCore', 'kotlinMultiplatform = { id = "org.jetbrains.kotlin.multiplatform", version.ref = "kotlin" }\nktor-clientCore')
+
+# If we somehow messed up and created a second [plugins] block, merge them
+lines = content.split('\n')
+clean_lines = []
+in_plugins2 = False
+for line in lines:
+    if line == '[plugins]' and '[plugins]' in clean_lines:
+        in_plugins2 = True
+        continue
+    
+    clean_lines.append(line)
+
+with open('gradle/libs.versions.toml', 'w') as f:
+    f.write('\n'.join(clean_lines))
+
